content:
maddy: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp exposed a few SDK vs REST differences that are causing customer confusion.

sam: what did you see?

maddy: three things: (1) camelCase -> snake_case mapping changes payload shape; (2) SDK adds an extra retry for 401s during the token refresh dance; (3) a missing REST-only endpoint (`/v1/admin/preview`) isn't surfaced in the SDK so docs show different behavior.

caroline: ugh. can you paste a minimal repro?

maddy: repro: in sampleapp we call `client.createCompletion({ model: 'redwood/mini', maxTokens: 120, stopSequences: ['\n\n'] })` — SDK sends `{"model":"redwood/mini","max_tokens":120,"stop_sequences":["\n\n"]}` and also injects header `x-sdk-transform: true`. REST curl uses `max_tokens` explicitly and no transform header. Server treats the SDK request as eligible for soft-retry.

li: why would the transform header flip retry semantics? that seems accidental.

sam: historical: transform header was added during migration to allow server-side compatibility fixes. some server rules treat transformed requests as idempotent and allow retry on auth errors. that bit is dangerous.

maddy: meanwhile, when a 401 happens because the short-lived token expired, auth middleware tries a refresh + retry. but there's a race — the retry attempt goes out before the refreshed token is attached, so the server sees an unauthenticated request and our retry logic fires again, which results in the sampleapp double-submitting the createCompletion flow (our backend writes a record twice).

caroline: two bugs then: server-side policy gating by transform header, and client-side auth racing causing duplicate side effects.

sam: suggested immediate mitigations: (A) SDK: stop auto-setting `x-sdk-transform` for user-facing quickstart paths; (B) SDK: treat 401 as non-retriable by default unless client opts in via explicit retry policy; (C) sampleapp: add optimistic dedupe for create endpoints until SDK fix lands.

maddy: added a quick failing test in sampleapp CI: `it('sdk==rest payloads', async () => { const body = { model: 'redwood/mini', max_tokens: 120 }; expect(await restGenerate(body)).toEqual(await sdkGenerate(camelize(body))); });` — fails because headers differ.

li: also filed an issue to track missing endpoint mapping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/565 — title: "SDK missing admin preview endpoint; docs mismatch". tagged @docs @eng-runtime.

caroline: I'll own the docs patch: add a callout in Quickstart noting known parity issues and add a small snippet showing how to call the missing endpoint via REST until SDK exposes it.

sam: longer-term: we should add a small parity CI job in the SDK repo that runs a matrix: SDK vs REST for representative payload shapes (streaming vs non-streaming, snake_case vs camelCase, function-calling shapes). Failures should be triaged before release.

maddy: agree. Also, let's add an instrumentation event when SDK emits `x-sdk-transform` so we can measure how many apps are affected.

devex-bot: deploy 1771304380: feature flag gate for `x-sdk-transform` on quickstart paths rolled out to staging.

li: small UX note — onboarding docs include a sample auth wrapper that returns early on 401 and queues a retry without awaiting token refresh. I'll submit a PR to make the wrapper await the refresh and then re-run the request.

caroline: and add a reversible opt-in to the SDK config: `retry: { on401: false }` default for now. we can change later.

sam: filing umbrella ticket to coordinate fixes and tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1203 — linking the SDK issue + sampleapp test + docs patch.

maddy: disabling the live demo until the staging flag proves the fix. leaving a short note in the onboarding repo.

li: thanks — I'll pick up the auth middleware fix today.

devex-bot: reminder in 48h: follow-up on #1771304321 parity fixes and CI additions.

sam: drop any other parity oddities here. particularly check function call payloads and streaming toggles. :eyes:
